title: Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE TEMPTATIONS OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Temptations of Jesus Christ, part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how they overcome temptations and share experiences in class. 1. How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. in pairs, brainstorm on the temptations they face in their daily lives,

2. read Luke 4:1-13 and describe temptations faced by Jesus Christ,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. in pairs, brainstorm on the temptations they face in their daily lives,
2. read Luke 4:1-13 and describe temptations faced by Jesus Christ,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Temptations of Jesus Christ together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: the skill of reflection on own learning is enhanced as learners brainstorm, in pairs, on the temptations

they face in day-to-day life.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of speaking clearly and effectively is enhanced as learners discuss, in small

groups, how Jesus Christ responded to the temptations He faced in the wilderness.

20

Values:
• Responsibility: learners learn to be resilient as they proactively overcome temptations.

• Unity: learners cooperate with others as they discuss, in small groups, how Jesus Christ overcame temptations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety and security: is enhanced as learners become aware of their safety and that of their family members.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Science and Technology skills are applied as learners watch a video clip about Jesus Christ’s temptations in the

wilderness.

• English: reading skills are enhanced as learners read Luke 4:1-13 and retell the story.
